title: Hearts2Hearts announce Japanese debut single "Iconic Heart"
summary: SM Entertainment announced Hearts2Hearts' official Japanese debut single, arriving in August 2026.
body: Hearts2Hearts will make their official Japanese debut with the single "Iconic Heart". The three tracks are pre-released on global music platforms on August 10, with the physical single following on August 12, 2026.

title: Second mini album "Lemon Tang" released
summary: Hearts2Hearts released their second mini album, followed by a showcase in Seoul.

title: First fan meeting "HEARTS 2 HOUSE" concludes
summary: The group's first fan meeting tour ran from February through March 2026, including stops outside Korea.
